sourced_facts.fact: Q2-2021 (quarter ended 2021-06-30), from the 2021-08-12 release: revenue was $50.7M, up 45.9% from $34.8M a year earlier. Branded revenue was $33.1M, up 62.3% from $20.4M. Gross profit was $8.0M (15.7% gross margin) versus $3.7M (10.8%) a year earlier. Net loss was $53.2M versus net income of $1.3M, and includes a one-time, non-cash $46.0M expense from a valuation allowance on a deferred tax asset. Adjusted EBITDA was negative $5.9M versus positive $2.0M. Source: SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex.99.1 copy of the GlobeNewswire release (the GlobeNewswire URL returned 403). Retrieved 2026-10-23.

FY2021 outlook as of 2021-08-12: revenue $235M-$242M (+58% to 63%, unchanged), gross margin 16%-22%, adjusted EBITDA negative $14M-$17M. Management cited 'increases in logistic costs, storage fees, legal and accounting fees, and marketplace shortages in packaging products.' Retrieved 2026-10-23.

Prior guide being cut (Q1-2021 release, 2021-05-12): FY2021 revenue $235M-$242M (+58% to 63%), gross margin 20%-25%, adjusted EBITDA positive $2M-$4M. Q1-2021 revenue was $52.7M (+59% YoY) at a 26% gross margin versus 27.9% in Q1-2020. The release also mentions the Foods of New Mexico acquisition, expected to close 'near-term', and a Karsten facility 'currently not in operation'; no price or closing date is given. Retrieved 2026-10-23.
